name: Get the Gnomes Drunk

meta.previous: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout
prev_q: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout

summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Get the Gnomes Drunk begins with a test of Fool's Stout on a pit crew. Kravel Koalbeard gives you the stout for the Gnome Pit Boss nearby and warns that it will go bad eventually.

sections.title: A Test on the Pit Crews
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard asks you to test Fool's Stout on one of the pit crews. Choose the gnomes, and he gives you the stout for the Gnome Pit Boss nearby at the Mirage Raceway. That choice tips the races toward the goblins. Kravel warns you not to wait too long, since the stout will go bad eventually.

sections.title: A Little Drink Before the Race
sections.body: The Gnome Pit Boss welcomes your gift and calls it considerate. A race is coming up, so drinking may not be wise. Still, the crew can probably manage a little. The stout cannot be that strong.

faq.q: Who asks you to deliver the stout?
aliases: who gives get the gnomes drunk
quest giver get the gnomes drunk
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard, the dwarf at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles, gives you the stout to deliver.

faq.q: To whom should the Fool's Stout be delivered?
aliases: where do i take the stout
faq.answer: Take the Fool's Stout to the Gnome Pit Boss, nearby at the Mirage Raceway.

faq.q: What happens if you take too long to deliver the stout?
faq.answer: The stout will go bad eventually, so Kravel tells you not to wait too long.

faq.q: Can you choose to target the goblins instead?
aliases: can i get goblins drunk instead
faq.answer: Yes. Kravel lets you choose which pit crew to test the stout on. The other choice is Get the Goblins Drunk.

aliases: prereq for get the gnomes drunk
faq.answer: It follows Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout.

faq.q: What comes after the stout is delivered?
aliases: what comes after get the gnomes drunk
faq.answer: After you deliver the stout, the chain continues with Report Back to Fizzlebub.
